title: Feedback drafts
intro: Pick a level for each criterion and the tool writes a feedback draft for you to edit, copy or save.
privacy: Everything stays in this page. Nothing you type is sent anywhere, and nothing is kept after you close the page.
sample_banner: This rubric is sample content, written to show how the tool works. Check it, or replace it with your own rubric, before you use it with a class.
opening_hint: Write {name} where the student's name should go.
draft_hint: You can edit the draft here. Changing a level, the name, the note or the rubric writes a new draft over your edits, so make those changes first.
copy_failed: The browser did not allow copying. The draft is selected: copy it with your keyboard.
